notes:
Status: Closed / stalled — POC not started. Key points below:
- Use case: ingest call audio -> ASR -> summarization + agent context (reranking for knowledge snippets). Primary ask: sub-200ms p95 for short-turn responses + batch rerank for nightly indexing.
- Security: high. Customer insisted on HSM integration and VPC/on-prem option; flagged data_residency (EU for some accounts). Security team required iso/SOC evidence and runbook for on-prem eval.
- Resourcing: customer could not commit engineering time for POC (hiring freeze Q4 2025). Quote from Head of AI (Maya Patel): "We can't dedicate product/infra headcount for a multi-week POC while hiring is frozen. If finance relaxes, we'll reconsider."
- Competitive outcome: selected vendor offered integrated ASR + single-vendor STT->LLM pipeline and a short free pilot; that beat our split-managed approach for Elmbridge's timelines.
- POC scoping: SE (Luis) delivered a tight POC plan (success metrics: p95 latency <200ms, stable KV cache for live agents, summary F1 > 0.72). Never resourced by Elmbridge.
- Action items logged: INF-4721 (security follow-up), drive deck (pricing + security FAQ) shared 2025-11-20, call transcript FF-20260112-elmbridge-call.
- Next steps: Close as lost in CRM; assign to AE for 6-month re-engagement. If budget reopens, revisit dedicated + on-prem package; consider bundling ASR partner to match competitor offering.
- Internal notes for GTM: highlights need for clearer commercial option that includes short ASR trial or partner integration to reduce friction for telco customers requiring voice pipelines.
